# Crypto Capital Monitor

> Independent crypto news and explainers for funds and trading desks.

Coverage: Capital flows, derivatives positioning, liquidity, collateral and settlement.
Editorial approach: Explain the transaction, trace the capital and identify the cost.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://aboutdefi.github.io/): Latest coverage and analysis.
- [About](https://aboutdefi.github.io/about/): Publication mission and editorial policy.
